name: Lilydale to Warburton Rail Trail

Runs from Lilydale to Warburton on gentle gradients with asphalt and fine gravel surface
Reached by train to Lilydale station; bus 683 runs along the trail

name: Coombe Yarra Valley Melba's Garden Walk

facts.claim: Seven-acre gardens of Dame Nellie Melba's 1909 home, designed by William Guilfoyle, with rare plants, terraced lawns and one of Victoria's oldest swimming pools
Gardens can only be seen on a 60-minute guided walking tour; the route is unsealed and not undercover
Hidden behind a 600 m cypress hedge, with native, Italian and vegetable gardens, a croquet lawn and grass tennis court
